faq.q: How many homes are for sale in North Shore (Port Moody)?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 14 houses and 43 condos and townhomes listed in North Shore (Port Moody). Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is North Shore (Port Moody) a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had 16% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in North Shore (Port Moody) from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 houses and 23 condos and townhomes sold in North Shore (Port Moody) over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in August with 2 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in July with 9 sold.

faq.q: How big is North Shore (Port Moody) compared with the rest of Port Moody?
faq.a: In September 2026, North Shore (Port Moody) held 10.4% of the 135 detached houses listed in Port Moody and 22.4% of the 192 condos and townhomes listed in Port Moody.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in North Shore (Port Moody)?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 24.6% of the 57 homes listed in North Shore (Port Moody) and condos and townhomes made up 75.4%; of the 7 that sold, houses were 0.0% and condos and townhomes 100.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in North Shore (Port Moody) than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses rose from 10 in June to 14 in September 2026 (+40.0%); condos and townhomes rose from 35 in June to 43 in September 2026 (+22.9%).
